item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so no headshot was generated.

The requested edit was limited to soft studio lighting, a navy blazer over an ivory blouse, and a neutral background—with explicit instructions to preserve your facial features, age, and natural skin texture. You’ll need more credits to run it.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a natural professional headshot of the exact same woman in the supplied portrait. Identity preservation is the highest priority: retain her exact facial proportions, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, eyebrows, hairline, natural age, expression and distinctive features. Preserve real skin texture, pores, fine lines and natural tonal variation. Do not make her younger, beautify or reshape her face, smooth or airbrush skin, add makeup, or alter her smile. Keep her dark curly hair and its natural texture. Change only wardrobe, lighting and background: replace the casual sweater with a well-fitted navy professional blazer over a simple ivory blouse, replace the park with a clean neutral warm-gray studio backdrop, and use soft flattering professional studio lighting with balanced exposure and natural skin color. Maintain the original front-facing head-and-shoulders pose and realistic photographic appearance. No glamour retouching or plastic skin.
